sermon.title: Save Yourself - October 22, 2023
sermon.speaker: Michael Silla
sermon.summary: After worship recalling David at Ziklag recovering all, the message on serving God in every season teaches how to save yourself from this perverse generation. You are responsible for your own relationship with God: pray yourself, put the word in you, be an example, submit to God and resist the devil, and choose like Joshua to serve the Lord.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: The service opens with worship (lyrics as captioned) and a special song (“Everybody Talks to God”) before the message at about 36:06. He cites Acts 2 for “save yourself from this perverse generation” (Acts 2:40).
